doc.name: HourProof
doc.description: Deterministic checker for self-reported service/volunteer hours: flags impossible day totals, bad dates, missing organizations, and long sessions, then collects a one-time supervisor sign-off and prints an A4 certificate. No LLM, no AI - arithmetic and completeness only. It does not decide whether hours satisfy any school or award requirement. This service is a plain REST API and an MCP server over Streamable HTTP - it is NOT an A2A JSON-RPC agent. Docs at the documentationUrl.

skills.name: Check logged service hours
skills.description: Check a list of logged hours for internal consistency (bad dates, day totals over 24h, missing organization, long-day flags). REST: POST https://hourproof.rowb.app/api/check-hours (bearer key). MCP tool: check_hours.

skills.name: Get the rule table
skills.description: The exact rule table the checker uses, with the reason each rule is checkable, and what it explicitly does not claim. MCP tool: get_rules.
